cards.title: School holidays: Parents share survival tips
cards.body: With six weeks of childcare to juggle, parents can take inspiration from orangutans who arrange playdates for their offspring. Scientists say play has significant health benefits for humans of all ages.

cards.title: New mothers' real concerns about birthrates
cards.body: New research reveals deep anxieties among new mothers as political leaders debate declining global birthrates. Policy solutions should prioritize addressing women's genuine concerns rather than offering medals or cash bonuses.

cards.title: Family gaming night brings Diamond family together
cards.body: After 20 years living together, the Diamond family shares one final video game session before their household changes. The evening reveals the joys and challenges of family bonding through gaming.

cards.title: Adopted and foster children need specialized support
cards.body: All adopted and foster children arrive with one or multiple childhood adversities requiring tailored parenting approaches. Evidence-based principles and strategies can help parents successfully navigate these relationships.

cards.title: Science-backed praise builds children's resilience
cards.body: The words parents choose when praising children significantly impact their confidence and love of learning. Science shows that specific praise helps children build resilience and adopt growth mindsets.

cards.title: Early conversations about donor conception matter
cards.body: Talking to children about their origins when young strengthens relationships and helps them understand their story. This transparency benefits both parent-child relationships and the child's emotional development.

cards.title: Postpartum psychosis: Understanding physiological shifts
cards.body: Postpartum psychosis is rooted in physiological changes rather than purely psychological factors. Understanding this connection helps parents and healthcare providers recognize and address the condition effectively.

cards.title: Financial bailouts of adult children come with costs
cards.body: When parents loan money to adult children, it often reflects a need to feel like a good parent rather than genuine generosity. Understanding this dynamic can lead to healthier family financial relationships.

cards.title: Teen's organ donation saves two lives
cards.body: After their 18-year-old daughter collapsed and died at home, her parents found solace in her heart and lungs being donated to save two others. Her legacy transformed family tragedy into life-saving impact.
